static_traits.name: Chen Bowen
static_traits.family_status: Having a pair of identical twin brothers
static_traits.social_status: Has a group of supportive friends to confide in, but struggling to discuss self-blame with them; relationships with peers strained by Self-doubt and self-blame
static_traits.medical_history: No history of similar psychological problems; never received psychotherapy; No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, Good logic; high cooperation, Positive attitude; able to self-Reflect; Low mood with Self-denial tendencies; showing avoidance and Withdrawal when academic/success topics are touched

basic_info.main_problem: After a film I acted in was released with poor box office/reception, immediately attributing the failure to my own performance, strong self-blame and personalization arising, further developing into Self-doubt and questioning of talent as an Actor/Artist; worsening whenever thinking of the film or my acting; rewatching the film and analyzing performance intensifying the self-blame.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling to deal with these negative thinking patterns, and to learn how to separate self-worth from external success or failure.
growth_experiences: Dropping out of college (about a month ago): feeling unable to keep up with coursework, repeatedly triggered by others' academic achievements into Sense of frustration, leading to the dropout decision; after dropping out persistently feeling 'a failure', feeling lower when seeing peers graduate or do well academically, often coping by avoiding related topics.

The film I acted in performed poorly after release: attributing the film's failure directly to my own performance, pressure and self-blame significantly heightened; trying to find causes by rewatching the film and analyzing my own shots, resulting in worsened self-blame and hopelessness, affecting on-set confidence, interpersonal interaction and self-esteem.

core_beliefs: My worth depends on external success or failure
I am not good enough in academics/ability

special_situations.event: The film I acted in released with poor box office/reception
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the work fails, it means my performance was not good, I must be responsible for the outcome
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly Reflecting and self-blaming, trying to 'correct mistakes' through self-blame
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: The movie flopped all because I acted poorly

special_situations.event: Seeing peers graduate or succeed academically
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have not completed my degree like my peers, I am just a failure, the future also cannot succeed
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids topics and occasions involving academics / success, reduces communication with others to avoid comparison
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never get my degree, I simply cannot do it

special_situations.event: Rewatches the film and focuses on one's own shots for frame-by-frame analysis
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I examine myself carefully enough, I will surely find the mistakes that caused the failure, thereby proving that I really am bad
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Over-analyzes and picks faults, ignoring other factors and positive parts
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: See, my performance really was terrible; I dragged down the whole film

special_situations.event: Thinking about their acting skills or professional abilities
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not always successful, it proves I have no ability/talent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Using total negation to simplify complex problems, reducing the sense of uncertainty
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am simply not suited for this path

core_conflict.wish: Longing for recognition and affirmation, being seen for one's value as an Actor/Artist
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being negated and humiliated due to failure, being looked down upon by others, ultimately being excluded
defense_goal: Preemptively punishing oneself through self-blame and internalized criticism to avoid more painful external negation
Maintaining Withdrawal and avoidance, reducing the risk of being compared and judged
Replacing emotional experience with Intellectualization analysis, reducing shame and helplessness

object_relations.self_representation: A failure/not-good-enough self needing constant self-proof
object_relations.object_representation: Others who judge and negate oneself (peer graduates, colleagues, audiences)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking of or being reminded of the box-office failure
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Attributing failure to 'It is all my fault', and Anticipating others will look down on oneself for it
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Gentle tone, first Empathizing with the self-blame and pressure; then inviting exploration of other possible factors, expanding evidence with open questions, avoiding direct refutation of their feelings.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: Repeatedly rewatching and technically analyzing one's own shots to reduce unease
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing that Anxiety can be controlled through rational analysis alone, avoiding directly facing shame and sorrow
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Slowing the pace, inviting them to name present emotions and body sensations; staying briefly with the emotion before returning to thinking while maintaining safety, reducing the tendency to analyze immediately.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing sensitive topics such as academics/success with others
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Fearing comparison and being negated, cutting off emotions from topics, choosing avoidance or brief responses
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Ensure relational safety and a measured pace, use gentle reflection and affect labeling, offer choices, encourage small-step exposure rather than pushing deeper.

manifestations: Tightly binds self-worth to external success or failure (movie box office, academic achievement)
Questioning the meaning and ability of oneself as an Actor/Artist after the film's failure
Feeling hopelessness and Self-deprecation in comparison with peers

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or things, or gives up seeking others to do something for them, instead doing it to themselves — turning libidinal energy that was directed outward back toward themselves.
manifestations: Choosing Silence or avoidance on academic/success topics, turning dissatisfaction and pressure into self-blame and internal friction
After the film fails, places all responsibility on oneself rather than discussing and sharing it with others/the situation

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Frequently labeling oneself as a 'failure' or 'incompetent'
Being cautious on set due to Self-doubt, with declining confidence
Relationship tension with peers and reduced interaction

exception_events.target_problem: When triggered by academic-related cues, the client typically engages in Self-denial with the thought 'I will never get the degree' and Avoids communication.
exception_events.unique_outcome: In a difficult course, the client once achieved a passing/good grade and did not give up as before, thus gaining a successful experience.
exception_events.reason: Clues: different actions (persisting in completing Learning tasks and exam prep) versus past avoidance; different understanding (realizing they also have the ability to overcome difficulties).

positive_force: Has achieved success in some subjects or difficult tasks, has evidence of the ability to overcome challenges
Has a supportive group of friends
Willing to seek help and accept cognitive-behavioral techniques (reality testing)
Able to engage in self-Reflection and willing to try small-step goals
negative_force: Habit of personalization and self-blame in thinking
Self-belittling triggered by comparison with peers
Avoidance and Withdrawal maintaining negative beliefs
A sense of hopelessness caused by labeling/overgeneralization
Impaired self-esteem, Decreased confidence on set

target_behavior.behavior: Blames the film's failure on oneself (self-blame and personalization)
antecedent: Thinking of the poor performance after the film's release
Recalling failures while working on set
target_behavior.core_reason: Personalizing and labeling cognitive distortions, attempting to gain a sense of control through self-reproach and avoid stronger negation from the outside
target_behavior.function: Gaining a short-term sense of being 'in control' and self-punishment to soothe Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired self-esteem, rising sense of hopelessness, Decreased confidence on set, Interpersonal tension

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids topics and socializing related to academics / success
antecedent: Seeing peers graduate or make academic progress
Comparison and achievement topics in social situations
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing comparison and being negated, triggering shame and a sense of failure
target_behavior.function: Avoiding uncomfortable emotions and potential judgment, reducing Anxiety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Social withdrawal, increased isolation, negative beliefs maintained and Reinforced

target_behavior.behavior: Repeatedly rewatches films and over-analyzes his own shots
antecedent: Thinking about the reasons for the film's failure
Wanting to find 'evidence' during Low mood
target_behavior.core_reason: Mental filtering and Intellectualization, attempting to confirm cause-and-effect and master uncertainty by finding faults
target_behavior.function: Replacing emotional experience with analysis, relieving uncertainty-driven Anxiety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Ignoring positive evidence, worsened self-blame, prolonged Low mood
